categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the automotive electronics sector, focusing on the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of automotive intelligent driving perception systems. Key products include in-vehicle camera systems, video driving recorders, ultrasonic radar systems, millimeter-wave radar systems, and domain control systems, all integrated with software, algorithms, optical design, and hardware.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as software and algorithm development, optical design, and hardware integration for automotive perception systems. It has strong capabilities in synchronous design and development with OEMs, high-standard software development certified by CMMI Level 3 and A-SPICE, comprehensive simulation and testing capabilities including thermal, mechanical, optical, and radar simulations, and in-house high-standard testing laboratories accredited by CNAS. The production follows a make-to-order and make-to-stock hybrid model based on customer demand forecasts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are domestic and international automotive OEMs, including major brands such as Volkswagen, Audi, Ford, Hyundai, BYD, XPeng, Li Auto, and others. The products are mainly sold for the automotive front-loading market with customized development for specific vehicle models. The company serves both domestic and overseas markets, with a significant portion of sales to domestic customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with manufacturing and R&D facilities located in Shenzhen and other cities. It has established subsidiaries in Wuhan, Chongqing, Vietnam, Germany, Japan, and Malaysia, supporting a global footprint. Sales are divided between domestic (approximately 65%) and international markets (approximately 35%).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 supplier providing intelligent driving perception systems directly to automotive OEMs. It procures raw materials such as chips, lenses, and electronic components from upstream suppliers and delivers integrated perception solutions downstream to vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology innovation driven by increased R&D investment, focusing on intelligent driving perception sensors, multi-modal sensor fusion, and intelligent driving system-level solutions. It pursues advanced ADAS functions including L2+ autonomous driving features, high-performance domain controllers, and integration of ultrasonic and millimeter-wave radar technologies. The company also plans to expand into robotics and low-altitude economy sensing products. It aims to enhance global manufacturing capabilities and digital transformation while strengthening customer collaboration and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive intelligent driving perception products to OEMs. The company follows a direct sales model with customized product development for specific vehicle models. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies, but the core revenue is from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic supplier of automotive intelligent driving perception systems with strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive testing facilities, and a broad customer base including top global and Chinese OEMs. It competes in the automotive electronics industry, particularly in the intelligent driving sensor segment, leveraging its synchronous development with OEMs and high-quality standards to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.41 billion, representing a 17.25% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 100.9 million, a decrease of 11.15% year-over-year. The company has total assets of RMB 2.21 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.31 billion, showing steady growth in scale. R&D investment accounted for over 11% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly integrated intelligent driving perception systems combining software, algorithms, optical design, and hardware tailored to specific vehicle models. Its competitive differentiation lies in strong synchronous development with OEMs, high-standard software and quality management systems, comprehensive simulation and testing capabilities, and a broad portfolio of patented technologies. This enables delivery of high-quality, reliable, and innovative products that meet stringent international automotive standards and customer requirements.
